question: For how long must one practice, and under what condition of wearing an ochre robe free from bondage, in order for the stated practice to apply?
premises: One who practices should do so from six months onward.
That practice is associated with wearing an ochre robe.
That ochre robe is described as free from bondage.
inference: One who wears an ochre robe free from bondage should practice for six months.
uncertainties: Object of practice not specified in this verse
plain_english: One who wears an ochre robe free from bondage should practice for six months.
